build_groupby_apply: build a groupby apply that applies a custom function group-wise and combines results
create_groupby_agg: create a groupby aggregation that applies one or more operations over specified axis
test_groupby_transform: test the groupby transform method that applies column-by-column transformations
summarize_groupby_stats: summarize the groupby statistics methods including mean, sum, count, and std
review_groupby_group: review the groupby get_group method that retrieves all rows for a specific group
